name: Connectors - New Data Connectors within Copy Job and Data Pipeline (Copy Activity)
description: While we have made great progress in addressing the most critical connector gaps between ADF and Data Factory in Fabric, a few connectors remain. During 2025, we will get to 100% parity by delivering on the following connectors across Data Pipeline & Copy Job: * Amazon RDS for Oracle* Cassandra * Google Ads* HDFS* Microsoft Access* Spark* Greenplum* Presto* Jira* Hive* HubSpot* Impala* IBM Netezza* Square* Shopify* XeroAdditionally, we will introduce net new connectors for:* Fabric CosmosDB (read-write)* SharePoint Online File (read-only)
